card.name: Newspaper and publishing context words
card.fires_on: Scattered words in passages about newspapers, books, gazettes and publishers, such as the period in 'Gazette No.', 'newspaper' before 'offices', or the colon after a city in a book citation.

modes.label: Gazette and citation marks
modes.description: Punctuation or numbers right after a gazette issue number or a publication place in a citation.

modes.description: Words inside sentences about newspapers, their offices, columns or advertisements.
